investigations.summary: PMM-T2004 fills the Data retention field, which percona/pmm#5792 makes read-only in HA by design; the test now asserts it is disabled in HA (reproduced on CHAOS HA, fix 3/3 green).

11 other HA failures (PMM-T1226, PostgreSQL dashboards BeforeSuite, T1061, T878, T2298, T300, T2039, T418, T506, T1988) are identical to the Oct 5 HA run and were not investigated this run; only T1988 is tracked (PMM-15583).
PMM-T2030 QAN filter click timed out (element resolved, not actionable) on client 3.9.1 only; it passed in every other lane both nights; timing-shaped, not reproduced, nightly cannot be re-run.

PMM-T2227 tarball upgrade exceeded the 120s test timeout before pmm-agent connected; same failure on Oct 5 (3.8.0 lane), siblings take 19s-1.5m, so the download-heavy test sits near its budget; root cause not yet established.
GitHub-hosted runners received a shutdown signal around 01:38-01:40 UTC and four jobs were cancelled mid-setup; not a pmm-qa or PMM defect.
